metadata.title: Zoomers Series - Banglamed - Last of us
metadata.description:
# Project Overview

**Zoomers Series - Banglamed - Last of Us** is a high-energy promotional motion graphics project created for **Banglamed Publication,** a specialized wing of **GENESIS**.

The campaign targets **Gen-Z medical students** ("The Zoomers"), introducing a comprehensive **MBBS Guide Series** meticulously redesigned to match the updated curriculum. The series currently features 7–9 textbook volumes—including **Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry, Pharmacology, Pathology, and Microbiology**—with more releases on the horizon.

This project carries profound personal significance. It marks a bittersweet milestone, serving as the final collaborative project guided by the outgoing Digital Marketer, whose last day on the wing coincided with the project's completion on May 24, 2026.

```
Creative Vision & Visual Breakdown
```
The promotional video utilizes a dynamic, multi-layered visual structure to transform dense academic material into engaging, youthful content:

- **3D Book Carousel:** A central feature of the video is a dynamic 3D carousel that showcases individual book volumes spinning along an active camera axis.

- **Hero Branding**: Integrated custom high-fidelity graphics featuring medical illustrations paired with modern UI elements.

- **Typography:** Bold, rhythmic typography layers presenting key highlights like "বিশাল সিলেবাস" (Massive Syllabus) and "নতুন কারিকুলাম অনুযায়ী সাজানো কনটেন্ট" (Content arranged per the new curriculum).

- **Interactive Framing:** A custom smartphone mock-up layer displaying the transition of digital content.


# Technical Breakdown

## Project Specifications

-** Footage Assets:** 17 collected files (61.2 MB total footprint) encompassing localized Bengali voiceover tracks, background music, 24fps high-definition stock video, and raw cover designs.

- **Rendering Engines:** Combined use of Adobe After Effects' Classic 3D space alongside CINEMA 4D layers to map out realistic book geometry.


# Advanced Animation Techniques & Keyframes

> Animations rely on custom Null Objects to drive complex mathematical sweeps, spatial orientation, and staggered opacity timings across individual book asset tracks.

A total of** 29 distinct effects** were deployed across layers to achieve the polished look. Notable effects include:

- **Distortion & Motion:** 
```
Turbulent Displace, Card Wipe, CC Page Turn, Puppet, and Pixel Melt.
```

- **Stylization & Lighting:**

```
Deep Glow 2, CC Light Sweep, Gradient Ramp, and Optics Compensation.
```


- **Transitions & Blurs:**
```
 Linear Wipe, Radial Wipe, CC Force Motion Blur, and Fast Box Blur.
```


``
---


> Last of Us" stands as a testament to working under impactful leadership. Though everyone ultimately pursues their own purpose, this piece captures the high-intensity creative synergy shared with our digital marketing lead up until their final day on May 24, 2026. It bridges meticulous asset organization with stylized, modern design choices tailored directly for the next generation of medical professionals.

>

metadata.title: Post FCPS Part-I, Residency Preparation - Genesis Combined
metadata.description:
# Project Overview
Post FCPS Part-I, Residency Preparation - MS Faculty is a vibrant, high-fidelity promotional banner designed for GENESIS Post Graduation Medical Orientation Centre.

The campaign targets medical professionals seeking advanced postgraduate guidance, specifically focusing on preparation for demanding medical academic paths like the FCPS Part-I and MS Residency programs. The banner spotlights a premium session hosted by MS Faculty member Dr. Saidul Islam Saikot—an expert credentialed in MBBS, FCPS Part-I (General Surgery), and MS Phase A (Colorectal Surgery) at BMU.

This specific project design stands as a monumental professional milestone. It represents the final design handover directly following a major structural management transition. This shift occurred when the previous Assistant Marketing Manager completed an intensive multi-year career journey on October 10, passing the creative torch forward within the group network.

>>**Creative Vision & Visual Breakdown**

The design leans heavily on modern geometric angles, striking contrast, and a futuristic academic color scheme to capture maximum visual attention:
- **Dynamic Vector Accents**: A bold, multi-layered yellow and black geometric vector shape slopes dynamically from the top-left corner to anchor the prominent "MS Faculty" title block.

- **Vibrant Backdrop Art:** A rich royal blue to deep magenta radial gradient is layered with subtle star vectors and sharp horizontal lens flare streaks to give the layout an elite, premium quality.

- **Polished Presentation UI:** Critical event coordinates are grouped inside clean, floating container cards with distinct drop shadows, highlighting an alarm clock icon next to the 06 Jun '26 date and a checkmark element indicating the 04:00 PM broadcast schedule.

- **Professional Profile Frame:** A sharp, masked studio portrait of the faculty speaker is embedded neatly within a custom-angled white container card with soft drop-shadow mapping.

## Advanced Layout Techniques & Vector Styling

Objects rely on independent appearance attributes to generate high-end depth effects natively in vector space without flattening the file structure.

A collection of advanced Illustrator styling attributes were configured across the vector groups to achieve a pristine commercial finish. Notable styles include:

- **Depth & Dimension:** 

 ```
Drop Shadow and Inner Glow styling mapped directly to the floating container panels and text characters.
```
- **Vector Transformations:**
```
Custom Offset Path mapping paired with precise anchor-point adjustments to craft the angled banner accents.
```

- **Color Mapping:**
```
Multi-stop Gradient Ramps used for the background panel and vibrant yellow title fillings.
```

>"Residency Preparation" represents a clean leap forward in corporate medical branding. It masterfully balances high-density information architecture with stylized, modern vector geometry, serving as a vital promotional tool built to inspire and attract the next generation of specialized medical specialists.
